title: Ownership record (SPEC section 15, row 'Ownership')
description: The three authority accounts and their Safe configurations. SPEC section 10.5 requires separate owner, treasury and seed Safes before mainnet; section 12.1 allows one operator Safe for all three on testnet. Signer identities, seeds and backup locations are never recorded here.

safeConfig.description: Sanitised Safe configuration: pinned implementation, owner count and threshold, fallback handler code hash. No signer addresses, no seeds, no backup locations (SPEC sections 10.5 and 15).

distinctKeyHolders.description: Whether distinct people control the keys. One person holding every key is not protection (SPEC section 10.5).

modulesEnabled.description: Must be false in this baseline: modules can bypass normal signature verification (SPEC section 10.5).

withdrawalSchedule.description: Treasury withdrawal schedule (SPEC section 15). Null for the owner and seed roles.

calldataDecodingPolicy.description: The signer calldata-decoding policy required by section 15. Never approve blind data.

finalOwner.description: Operator-controlled multisig that owns Vault and Draw after the two-step transfer is accepted.

feeAccount.description: Dedicated treasury Safe that receives the 3% fee. Never the Vault or the Draw.

seedAccount.description: Dedicated operator Safe holding an ordinary Vault balance, never the keeper key (SPEC section 5.4).

ownershipAccepted.description: Both Ownable2Step transfers have been accepted. A deployed fact, so it is absent from a plan.

makeWholeReserve.description: Make-whole reserve (SPEC sections 7.3 and 15) in wei of the chain's native coin, held in the treasury Safe; null until funded. The web app displays it in the native symbol with 18 decimals.

makeWholeCap.description: Per-incident make-whole cap, in wei of the chain's native coin like the reserve; null until published.

safes.description: Sanitised Safe configurations, at most one per role.

ownershipAccepted.$comment: Constrained in $defs/ownershipCommon; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.
